allOf.description: The step record (state.md#2.8): the step result plus what the hook adds (hooks.md#2.11.7). store_step(project, result, agent_type, worktree_head).

agent_type.description: The calling agent's type from the hook payload, stored by the step-results rule.

worktree_head.description: The head commit of the unit's worktree when the result was stored. Named apart from the step result's `head` (the commit the step left): one key must not carry two meanings.
